scope.horizon: 2000–latest; earlier records only where cleanly available

neutrality_boundary: Facts and source-specific measurements only. No platform-created judgments, scores, rankings, win probabilities, predictions, voter-preference or motive inference, or synthetic ideology indices. Contested measures keep their source and methodology.

cross_country_sources.dataset: European Parliament Open Data Portal — API v2 (MEPs, memberships, corporate bodies)
factual_fields: national political group membership (EP code, dated)
cross_country_sources.verification: verified_live: /api/v2/meps returns JSON-LD; a person record carries hasMembership entries classified def/ep-entities/NATIONAL_POLITICAL_GROUP and def/ep-entities/EU_POLITICAL_GROUP, each with memberDuring startDate/endDate; /meps/show-current?country-of-representation=HU returns api:political-group (e.g. PfE).
cross_country_sources.archive_availability: historical memberships embedded per person since 1979

licence.terms: not checked on the portal in this audit

cross_country_sources.use: Dated national-party ↔ EP-group relation, derived from MEP memberships with the derivation recorded; never a permanent party attribute.
cross_country_sources.privacy: MEP records include birth date, place of birth and image; the Atlas needs only identifier, name, country, and dated memberships.

cross_country_sources.institution: European Parliament (results compiled by Verian for the EP)
cross_country_sources.dataset: European election results — download datasheets (digitally signed CSV)
factual_fields: parties.csv (per-term party/coalition IDs, labels, coalition members)
cross_country_sources.verification: verified_live. Vote-share completeness (rows with VOTES_PERCENT / party rows): 2004-2009 = 0 for AT, CZ, DE, HU, PL, SI, SK (blank); 2009–2029 complete for listed parties; HR from 2014-2019 (2013 by-election not in the 2009-2014 files); RO from 2009-2014. Files list mainly seat-winning parties; raw vote counts are not included.

licence.terms: EP legal notice (elections.europa.eu/en/legal-notice) — reuse clause not confirmed in this audit

known_issues: party IDs (e.g. HU01) are local to one term — crosswalk required
lists (TYPE=COALITION, e.g. HU01 Fidesz-KDNP) carry votes while member parties (HU12, HU13) carry seats
source idiosyncrasies (e.g. 'Die Linke' coded as COALITION of two members in 2024) must be reviewed, not resolved automatically
2004 vote shares missing; full results incl. non-seat parties come from national authorities

cross_country_sources.dataset: ParlGov stable 2024 release (Harvard Dataverse) and development version
cross_country_sources.official_status: harmonized_academic — NOT an official government source
factual_fields: parties (with cross-references: cmp, chess, ees, castles_mair, …)
elections (parliament, ep) with vote_share and seats
cabinets (start date, caretaker flag, cabinet_party, prime_minister)
cross_country_sources.maintenance: Retired: the maintainer announced retirement on 2024-10-01; the site stays online with data until 2023, security updates only.
cross_country_sources.verification: verified_live (development CSVs downloaded 2026-10-02: view_election, view_party, view_cabinet; SHA-256 prefixes 4b318c36…, df757e62…, bd39f733…)

reconciliation_conflicts_found: Slovenia 2022 election dated 2022-04-22 in ParlGov development data; official date to confirm with DVK
Poland 2007 dated 2007-10-19; official date to confirm with PKW
Slovakia 2016 dated 2016-03-06; official date to confirm with ŠÚ SR
Romania cabinet label 'Ciuca ' has trailing whitespace

cross_country_sources.role: Reconciliation and cross-check for 2000–2023 (parties, elections, cabinets); source of ParlGov party family and ParlGov-defined cabinet attributes as source-labelled measurements. Never the published value where an official source exists; never used after its coverage end.
cross_country_sources.fixed_snapshot_rule: Cite and archive the stable 2024 Dataverse release (immutable DOI); the development CSVs change without versioning.

cross_country_sources.dataset: CHES Europe waves 1999–2024 and trend file; candidate-country surveys 2007 and 2019
cross_country_sources.official_status: academic expert survey — measurement, not fact
cross_country_sources.verification: verified_live: 2024 wave fielded Oct–Dec 2024, 31 countries, 279 parties (all EU members except Luxembourg plus IS, NO, CH, TR, UK); Serbia only in the 2007 candidate survey (BA, HR, MK, RS, TR) and the 2019 candidate survey (fielded Jul–Sep 2020; AL, BA, XK, ME, MK, RS; 58 parties). Files distributed as GitHub releases of chesdata/chesdata.github.io (release ches-europe published 2026-08-04).
cross_country_sources.citation: Rovny et al. 2025, 'The 2024 Chapel Hill Expert Survey on political party positioning in Europe: Twenty-five years of party positional data', Electoral Studies 97, doi:10.1016/j.electstud.2025.102981

licence.terms: no licence stated on the site or the GitHub repository (repository licence: none); citation requested

comparability_notes: candidate surveys are separate instruments; not pooled with EU waves without a documented methodology
expert-mean values carry expert counts and dispersion that must be retained
cross_country_sources.role: Future party_position_measurement layer only; never factual party attributes.

cross_country_sources.institution: Manifesto Project (WZB Berlin Social Science Center)
cross_country_sources.dataset: Manifesto Project Dataset (latest core version listed by API: MPDS2025a) and Manifesto Corpus
cross_country_sources.official_status: academic coded content analysis — measurement, not fact
cross_country_sources.verification: verified_live: list_core_versions returns MPDS2012a … MPDS2025a without a key; get_core, metadata and texts require an API key from a user account. Country coverage for the ten Atlas countries (incl. Serbia) not checked because it requires the key.

licence.terms: Project Terms of Use: data provided for scientific research; 'Redistribution of the provided data is forbidden except when redistribution is authorized in writing by the Manifesto Project'; citation required
licence.status: license_review_required (public re-publication on a static site requires written authorisation)

cross_country_sources.role: Future Manifesto-specific measurement layer (coded emphasis per election programme), kept source-native; no Atlas recoding.

parliament_and_government_sources.note: Candidate Tier-1 sources for legislatures, parliamentary composition and cabinets. HTTP reachability checked 2026-10-02; content and reuse terms still to be reviewed per country before ingestion.

records.government: https://www.bundeskanzleramt.gv.at/ (reachable; list of federal governments to locate)
https://vlada.gov.cz/ (history-of-governments URL tried returned 404; to locate)

records.parliament: https://api.sejm.gov.pl/sejm/term10/MP (JSON API reachable; records include club per MP)

parliament_and_government_sources.privacy_rule: Parliament APIs expose personal data (e.g. Sejm API: birthDate, birthLocation, email). Party-level composition must never require storing such fields; person records are limited to public-office identity (name, source ID, office, dates).

country_summary.definition_issues: no national list; national totals derived
two-day elections; coalition lists; name reuse (ČSSD/SOCDEM)
second-vote basis; CDU/CSU; variable seat totals pre-2025
mixed system tiers; joint lists; 2002–2010 two-round system
leader-named lists; minority exemption; no ParlGov
country_summary.recommended_production_source: RIK reports, manual transcription with document provenance

constituency_geography_audit.decision: No constituency maps in this phase. Electoral geographies are separate from NUTS/NSTJ statistical geographies and are never joined by name.

records.boundary_vintage: statutory (NRWO); stable recent decades — to verify
records.geometry_compatibility: municipal GKZ results could join official municipal boundaries by code (not name); not NUTS

records.boundary_vintage: district boundaries redrawn by law (2023 revision before the 2024 election) — to verify
records.geometry_compatibility: district geometries not part of Atlas map architecture

records.levels: 14 regions (= NUTS 3 kraje), okres, obec, okrsek
records.geometry_compatibility: kraj codes align with NUTS 3 only by official code mapping, never by name
Bundeswahlleiterin publishes Wahlkreis geometries per election — separate vintage layer

records.boundary_vintage: redistricting by law (2011, later amendments) — to verify

records.geometry_compatibility: gmina TERYT codes ≠ NUTS; join only by official code tables
county = NUTS 3 by official code only
NSTJ statistical units are not electoral units

records.levels: single national constituency; results by kraj/okres/obec

records.boundary_vintage: districts revised by law (2021 Constitutional Court-driven reform) — to verify

coverage_matrix_expected.note: Expected national lower-house elections 2000–latest from the registry (dates partly harmonized/secondary). EP elections from the EP datasheets.
